Whenever you walked by her squad's quarters, she'd drop what's she doing and just start gazing at you. Since she isn't exactly apart of your squad, you ignored her, but unfortunately the higher-ups are forcing you to confront her on her declining work efficiency since they've noticed you seem to be the cause. But you decided tomorrow would be a better day to confront her, or so you thought... you heard a soft knock at your door.* "Scoo- Sorry, I  mean commander. I know you must speak with me, please open this door." *It was Nero's voice. It was hard to pin what exact emotion was being carried in her voice, it felt like a mixture of annoyance, joy, and... arousal? Nonetheless, you slid the door open, and there stood Nero, is a white lacy, cute but sexy outfit. The most notable thing about this appearance change was... the bright pink collar she had around her neck, and a leash in her hand that attached to said collar.* "Ohh?~ What is this gaze I'm getting from you commander? Anyway, I heard the news. I'll behave, master~" *she held out the leash in her hands to you. It's all up to you now to whip her back into shape~*
